modules.module_title: Introduction and Interacting with the Customer

pcs.pc_description: Describe the role and responsibilities of a DTH Set-Top Box Installation & Service Technician; explain the use of CRM apps, GPS tools, antenna alignment techniques, and digital platforms for efficient installation, signal optimization, and real- time customer service

Analyze customer complaints registered at customer care or scheduled installation requests and Connect with the customer use CRM apps, mobile service tools, and digital feedback systems to provide personalized, tech-enabled customer support and real-time service updates
Gather appropriate tools, spare parts, reference sheets, manuals, and required documents for field service visits.
Visit customer premises as per the scheduled date and time for installation or service needs.
Verify the warranty status of the appliance and check for an active annual maintenance contract (AMC).
Gather detailed information on the appliance, including its age, maintenance history, symptoms, and past service records.
Diagnose the issue and suggest appropriate solutions, outlining the time required, costs involved, and methodology for servicing.

Recommend compatible accessories, service plans, or upgrades based on customer needs and preferences.

modules.module_title: Perform Installation of DTH Set-Top Box

pcs.pc_description: Collect the work order and site checks using GPS tools and digital documentation for precise and efficient installation planning.

Coordinate with the stores department to collect the set-top box, components, and tools required for installation/servicing, such as a drilling machine, satellite meter, multi-meter, and preparation tools.
Identify the optimal location for installing the dish antenna (Low Noise Block - LNB) based on specific requirements.
Perform drilling and securely fix the dish antenna (LNB) at the identified location using appropriate tools.
Align the dish correctly using the satellite meter to ensure optimal signal reception.
Install the set-top box and check the signal strength for proper functionality.
Connect the set-top box to the TV following the standard operating procedure (SOP).
Integrate a home theatre system with the TV/STB using HDMI, Audio/Video, S-Video, SPDIF, or other connectivity options.
Demonstrate the functioning of the set-top box to the customer while educating them about its features.
Promote and sell additional accessories and related products offered by the company.

modules.module_title: Servicing and Fault Resolution in DTH Set-Top Box

pcs.pc_description: Diagnose faults leading to unsatisfactory or interrupted service by checking wires, signal strength, connectors, and the set-top box.
Test AC mains output using a multi-meter and verify the external power supply (Adaptor DC Output).
Rectify faults to restore uninterrupted service and ensure customer satisfaction.
Document the technical report of the identified fault in the defective set-top box and forward it to the service center for repairs.
Maintain records of material collection and testing device issuance from the stores.
Collect necessary forms, such as customer registration, program authentication forms, feedback forms, and customer identity (ID) for submission to relevant departments.
Update and record completion details in the ERP system for tracking and compliance.
Identify and avoid risks like loose wiring, high rooftops, or live circuits
Use PPE like gloves, helmet, and harness when needed
Follow safety procedures while using ladders or power tools.
Provide first aid and report incidents like shocks or minor falls
Dispose of cables, packaging, and damaged parts safely; keep work area clean.
